resolution_notes: Disputed free_tier_limits: Verifier B is right that 1,000 req/hour is the shared default (not free-only); product free limits remain ~5 users / 1 GB / 50 build min. Official rate-limit docs: https://support.atlassian.com/bitbucket-cloud/docs/api-request-limits/; pricing: https://bitbucket.org/product/pricing.
free_tier_limits: Free plan includes API access; default API rate limit 1,000 req/hour (shared across plans, not free-only). Product free: ~5 users, 1 GB storage, 50 build min/mo; higher rate limits for larger Standard/Premium workspaces with access tokens or Forge
